title: Wiki configuration
description: Per-wiki branding and behavior. Edit directly or run `npm run init`.

url.description: Production URL with protocol. MUST be the host that serves 200 DIRECTLY, not one that redirects: Docusaurus turns this into every absolute URL the site emits (og:image, og:url, canonical), and a scraper that does not follow a redirect drops the share card entirely.

noindex.description: If true, robots noindex meta + disable sitemap

description.description: Site description used in llms.txt header

gate.description: How this wiki's password gate is unlocked by a link. Read by scripts/unlock-link.mjs (pnpm share). Absent means the family convention.

unlockParam.description: The query parameter that carries the password in a prefilled link. `key` is the family convention and the default; reallife and the garysheng.com properties use `password`. null declares that no query-string unlock exists, so the CLI never builds one.

hero_register.description: How this wiki's article heroes get made. `mode` picks the engine and nothing else about a page changes when it moves: both engines emit the same five artifacts (deploy WebP, source PNG, provenance recipe beside the WebP, verbatim-prompt alt text, frontmatter image), so a wiki graduates from local to abu by editing one field.

mode.description: local: the vendored generator at illustrations/scripts/, no ABU install needed. abu: the shared wiki-article-hero form, via abu:make-a-work. Absent means abu, so wikis predating this field keep working.

layout.description: multipanel is the default. A hero is a strip of beats; one plate is the exception.

defaultPanels.description: Beats per hero when layout is multipanel. 3 is the default.

register.description: One sentence naming the visual register, passed first on every render. Never name a living or recent illustrator; OpenAI moderation hard-blocks those. Describe the tradition instead.

spec.description: Path to the fuller visual spec. Prose for humans and agents; the register string above is what actually reaches the model.

refs.description: Blessed style references, all passed on every render. 2 to 4 is enough to lock a look without a recurring character.

outputDir.description: Where deploy assets land. Default static/img/illustrations.

universe.description: mode abu only. Path to the universe supplying the register and cast.

form.description: mode abu only. The form id, normally wiki-article-hero.

stylePack.description: mode abu only. Style pack path within the universe.

characterRef.description: mode abu only. Locked character master.

motifRefs.description: mode abu only. Locked motif plates.

intake_mode.description: How this wiki grows. source-grounded: fold in external sources faithfully with citation. authored-canon: author net-new original philosophy that coheres with the canon. Drives which intake skill scripts/init-intake-skill.sh scaffolds into static/skills/.

skill_prefix.description: Namespace for this wiki's skills when registered into the global registry (e.g. 'humanperformance' -> humanperformance-intake). Defaults to projectName minus a trailing -wiki. Used by scripts/register-skills.sh.

og.description: Brand tokens for the auto-generated per-page social share cards (plugins/og-image-plugin). Every page without a frontmatter `image:` hero gets a card built from these at build time. Omit for the template defaults.

accent.description: Accent color for the kicker and bar (hex)
